context: Evaluates correct setup of ESLint v9 flat configuration using neostandard for a TypeScript project. The candidate must produce a valid eslint.config.mjs that uses the neostandard() factory, enables TypeScript support, and configures ignores. Focus is on correct use of the ESLint v9 flat config API and the neostandard package.
capability_tested: ESLint v9 Flat Config with Neostandard

checklist.name: eslint.config.mjs format
checklist.description: File is named eslint.config.mjs and uses ES module syntax (`export default [...]`) as required by ESLint v9 flat config

checklist.name: neostandard() integration
checklist.description: Calls neostandard() and spreads its result into the config array (e.g. `...neostandard()`) rather than manually specifying individual rules

checklist.name: TypeScript support
checklist.description: Enables TypeScript linting via neostandard's `{ ts: true }` option or typescript-eslint integration, so .ts files are linted with TypeScript-aware rules

checklist.name: Ignore patterns
checklist.description: Adds an `ignores` config entry that excludes `dist/**` and `node_modules/**` from linting

checklist.name: No legacy .eslintrc usage
checklist.description: Does not use any legacy .eslintrc-style configuration; the entire config is expressed in the flat config format
